title: Zesty Brazilian Cheese-Pull Pão de Queijo
description: A crowd-pleasing Brazilian dish featuring a delicious cheese-pull, with a hint of kabse spice. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine potato starch, grated cheese, kabse spice, and a pinch of salt. Mix well until the cheese is evenly distributed.
Add in the eggs and mix until the dough comes together. It should be slightly sticky, but hold its shape.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each one into a ball.
Place the balls onto a parchment-lined bamboo tray, leaving about 1 inch of space between each ball.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the dough is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
To serve, place a bamboo skewer into the cheese-pull and twist to pull apart.
Repeat with the remaining skewers and serve immediately.
For an added touch, drizzle with a bit of coconut oil and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the oven at 350°F for 5-7 minutes, or until warm and crispy on the outside.
To make the coconut oil drizzle, simply melt a tablespoon of coconut oil in a small saucepan over low heat.
Strain the melted oil into a small bowl and let cool slightly before serving.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve alongside the cheese-pull.
